```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden signed three executive orders and a presidential memorandum to stand up for reproductive rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is protecting access to abortion, including by creating a new path for pharmacies to dispense FDA-approved medication abortion.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is defending access to abortion in court.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is expanding reproductive health care for service members, veterans, and their family members.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is defending access to emergency medical care, including clarifying that federal law on emergency care preempts state abortion bans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is educating patients on their rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is making it easier for patients who have been denied emergency care to file a complaint.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is ensuring hospitals meet their legal obligations to offer care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is challenging threats from Republicans to prosecute people who help women travel to a different state for abortion care.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is helping states expand access under Medicaid for women who travel from states with bans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is safeguarding patients' and providers' privacy, including by strengthening HIPAA protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is cracking down on the illegal sharing of personal information.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is strengthening consumer data protections.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is issuing guidance to protect student privacy in this area.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is ensuring access to accurate information and legal resources, including by launching ReproductiveRights.gov.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration convened more than 200 lawyers and advocates to support abortion-related legal defense services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump's Supreme Court appointees overturned Roe v Wade, eliminating a fundamental constitutional right and denying women across the nation the right to choose.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Overturning Roe v Wade, which had been the law of the land for nearly half a century, has already had devastating consequences nationwide.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than 20 states have imposed extreme and dangerous abortion bans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many abortion bans include no exception even for rape or incest.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Abortion bans put the health and lives of women in jeopardy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Abortion bans force women to travel hundreds of miles for care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Abortion bans threaten to criminalize doctors for providing the health care that their patients need and that they are trained to provide.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Laws limit access to contraception and to fertility treatments like IVF.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Laws limiting access to contraception and fertility treatments like IVF were first adopted in the 1800s.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than one in three women of reproductive age now live under an abortion ban.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More than half of Black women now live under an abortion ban.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"40 percent of Latinas now live under an abortion ban.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today, daughters have fewer rights than their grandmothers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden, Vice President Harris, and Democrats are fighting back to restore reproductive freedom for every woman in every state.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
